digest.component_or_area: LLM model class resolution and verifier selection
propositions: Three separate code paths for verifier model selection use equality tests against DEFAULT_MODEL that silently fail when the model string is provider-qualified, leaving verifiers on frontier models instead of applying the configured standard class
Code-review's verify step declares no model: key and temperature: 0 setting, so the step silently runs on cfg.model (frontier) with temperature ignored, losing the determinism its own config claims
resolve_model and the batch-runner ladder paths do not call resolve_model_string, so class names in workflow YAML pass through as literal strings instead of resolving to configured model ids

A single resolution function resolve_model_string must be wired into all four verifier call sites and the workflow step resolver so that reserved class names (trivial/standard/frontier) resolve through load_class_slots while literal model ids pass unchanged

Code-review's verify step must declare model: standard to defer to operator class configuration and enable its temperature: 0 setting, and tests must assert all verifier paths resolve the standard class regardless of cfg.model or provider qualification
